components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Booking CTA on dark or paper.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; height:48px; padding:0 32px; background:#7D0B29; color:#F1EFE9; font-family:Onest,sans-serif; font-size:15px; font-weight:600; border-radius:4px; text-decoration:none; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:#930E31; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #F1EFE9; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; height:48px; padding:0 24px; background:transparent; color:#08090B; border:1px solid rgba(8,9,11,.2); font-size:14px; font-weight:600; border-radius:4px; text-decoration:none; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background:#08090B; color:#F1EFE9; }
